_comment: Floor for bin/test/release-names-head.test.mjs — the known remainder of the anonymisation C3 programme AT HEAD. Keyed on PATH only, never a count or a line. Entries are removed by re-seeding as each cleanup LANDS; nothing is ever added to accept a new offender. IDENTITY SUBSTRINGS ARE JSON \u-ESCAPED so this file does not itself publish the names it floors: JSON.parse yields the true path while the raw bytes carry no literal, so it does not trip the very gates it feeds. Do not "tidy" the escapes away.
